verdict.rationale: A probe got HTTP 200 for a real robots.txt at direct.sos.state.tx.us that names specific agents (GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, Googlebot), so an agent can learn its access rules before fetching; the policy is restrictive, but the story asks only that the rules be published, and they were. Missing for 10: no evidence of a robots.txt on the main www.sos.state.tx.us host or the new SOSPortal host, the probed file sits on the legacy SOSDirect host, and there is no first-party documentation of the crawler policy.
